name: lyric-video
label: Animated scripture / lyric video (The Wait Culture)

brief.Goal (one sentence): Carry one scripture or lyric line by line so it can be read, felt and shared.
brief.Where it will be used: Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, WhatsApp Status, release posts
brief.Must-say copy / CTA: The exact verse or lyric, the reference and the translation (e.g. KJV)
brief.Audio: Beatless pad or the song itself (cleared); paper rustle per card
brief.Look & feel references: Ben Marriott: paper cut-outs, ink-bleed type, hand-drawn underline, motion on twos

panels.title: Phrase 1
panels.action: Paper strip lands on twos; the phrase inks in; emphasis word underlined.

panels.title: Phrase 2
panels.action: Previous strip pulled away; next strip lands.

panels.title: Phrase 3…
panels.action: One phrase per card for the rest of the text.

panels.title: End card
panels.action: Reference inks in large; translation stamp; overline.

hardRules: Scripture text matches the stated translation word for word; the reference and translation are on screen.
Lyrics only for songs owned or cleared by The Wait Culture.
One phrase per card; one or two emphasis words per phrase, no more.
Portrait line breaks are set by hand with "|" so no line ends on an orphan word.
visualNotes: Recipe: illustrated-type (Ben Marriott) with atmosphere sound. Template ScriptureLyric.
Songs: set "lyricSync": true and "seconds" to the song length on the motion deliverables; time the cards with npm run lyrics (studio-edit skill §6).

motionVocabulary.name: Cut-out on twos
motionVocabulary.how: CutoutStrip: torn-edge strip lands in 6 frames with a slight overshoot; positions held on twos.

motionVocabulary.name: Ink bleed
motionVocabulary.how: InkText: characters arrive blurred and scaled, then firm up; edge displacement settles from 9 to 1.6 and boils on twos.

motionVocabulary.name: Hand underline
motionVocabulary.how: HandUnderline: hand-wobbled path drawn with evolvePath over 12 frames after the emphasis word lands.

motionVocabulary.name: Pull away
motionVocabulary.how: Strip leaves up and off in 6 frames (ease-in), with a 3-frame breath before the next card.

qaChecklist: Every emphasis word appears in its phrase.
Text checked word for word against the translation.
Footer reference visible on every card; end card shows reference + translation.
